name: Wood Golem
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can’t speak

traits.name: Alarm
traits.text:
Whenever a creature other than its creator comes within 60
feet of the golem, it releases an audible alarm sound which can
be heard out to a range of 300 feet.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.text:
The golem is immune to any spell or effect that
would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text:
The golem has advantage on saving throws against
spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapon
traits.text: The golem’s weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The wood golem makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12
(2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
